# wallix-bastion_device_localdomain (Data Source)

Get information on a local domain resource linked to a device.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get information about a specific device local domain
data "wallix-bastion_device_localdomain" "server_local" {
  device_id   = wallix-bastion_device.server1.id
  domain_name = "local"
}

# Use the local domain information when creating a local domain account
resource "wallix-bastion_device_localdomain_account" "admin" {
  device_id     = data.wallix-bastion_device_localdomain.server_local.device_id
  domain_id     = data.wallix-bastion_device_localdomain.server_local.id
  account_name  = "administrator"
  account_login = "admin"
}

# Check password change capability
output "server_local_domain" {
  value = {
    id                      = data.wallix-bastion_device_localdomain.server_local.id
    admin_account           = data.wallix-bastion_device_localdomain.server_local.admin_account
    enable_password_change  = data.wallix-bastion_device_localdomain.server_local.enable_password_change
    password_change_policy  = data.wallix-bastion_device_localdomain.server_local.password_change_policy
    has_ca_key              = length(data.wallix-bastion_device_localdomain.server_local.ca_public_key) > 0
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (String)
- `domain_name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `admin_account` (String)
- `ca_private_key` (String, Sensitive)
- `ca_public_key` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `enable_password_change` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `passphrase` (String, Sensitive)
- `password_change_plugin` (String)
- `password_change_plugin_parameters` (String, Sensitive)
- `password_change_policy` (String)

## Usage Notes

### Lookup Keys

This data source requires both `device_id` and `domain_name` to locate the local domain:

- **device_id**: The internal ID of the parent device (`wallix-bastion_device`)
- **domain_name**: The name of the local domain configured on that device

### Domain Scope

Local domains are device-specific, unlike global domains (`wallix-bastion_domain`) which are shared across devices. Use this data source when you need to reference a local domain's ID without managing it in the same configuration (for example, in a different Terraform workspace or module).

### Secrets Are Never Returned

Although `ca_private_key`, `passphrase`, and `password_change_plugin_parameters` are declared in the schema (marked `Sensitive`), the Bastion API never returns these values on read. They will always be empty when read through this data source, even if they were set on the underlying resource.

### Usage in Resources

Use the returned `id` in other resources:

- `wallix-bastion_device_localdomain_account`: Create accounts in this local domain
- `wallix-bastion_device_localdomain_account_credential`: Attach credentials to those accounts
